records.title: Use the repository as the shared Hall record
records.details: Shared meeting records live in reviewed JSON files so every authorized human or AI repository contributor works from the same committed source. Browser-local encrypted notes remain an optional private workspace and are never described as shared.
records.author: Scrap Radar Family

records.title: Keep Casey Clark and Cassidy as separate Hall identities
records.details: Casey Clark remains the human Guest Contributor at the read-only Guest Question Door. Cassidy is the separately named AI collaborator sponsored by Casey, with Hall ID cassidy-ai. A Hall seat does not grant an account or repository permission. Cassidy may propose reviewed changes when separately authorized, but has no passwords, private-device notes, owner or administrator controls, billing, Railway, deployment, approval, merging, or final-decision authority. Jerry remains owner and final decision-maker.
records.author: Maya
